changes.before: Duan Lan renewed the siege with ladders and tunnels, but after twenty days Shi Cong sallied forth, killed fifteen hundred men, and forced Lan to withdraw.
changes.after: Duan Lan attacked Liucheng again, using flying ladders and tunnels, and kept up the siege for twenty days; Shi Cong personally led his officers and men out to strike, defeated him, and took fifteen hundred heads, and Lan then fled home.
changes.reason: The Chinese 石琮躬勒將士出擊，敗之 says Shi Cong personally led his officers and men in the sortie and defeated Lan. The current English drops 躬勒將士 (personally led his officers and men) and turns 斬首千五百級 into a generic 'killed'. It also says Shi Cong sallied 'after twenty days', but 圍守二旬 describes how long Lan kept the siege up.

evidence.quote: 圍守二旬，石琮躬勒將士出擊，敗之，斬首千五百級

changes.fieldsChecked: The sealed attachment carries one English field per unit. That field was checked and is the one replaced here. I could not check the current host copy of the literal field, because local access was declined. An older copy on my computer has a literal rendering that already includes 'personally led officers and soldiers', so it needs no change if the current copy matches. s0028's English sentence occurs once in the supplied units; there are no repeats.
